Questions, answered plainly. You do not need to know the technical terms or be certain that something is wrong. What should I send in the first message? A short, neutral message through WhatsApp or Signal, such as: "I'd like a private conversation. Please let me know the next step." You receive a personal reply as soon as possible. Do not send passwords, recovery codes, screenshots, legal documents, intimate material or details, or detailed allegations in that first message. Keep identifying case details out of it as well. Can someone notice my contact with Toza? Contact through WhatsApp or Signal is not guaranteed to be invisible on your device or account. Keep the first message short and neutral. Is the first conversation the paid service? No. The first conversation checks whether Toza fits your situation, whether anything appears urgent and what the next step should be. It is free and includes no device inspection, mapping, diagnosis or technical work. Contacting Toza does not commit you to a purchase. What happens before I pay? If the service fits, you receive a written offer with the work, inclusions, exclusions, price, agreed additions and payment terms. You accept it explicitly and pay; then the visit is scheduled. No paid work starts before acceptance and receipt of payment. Preparation instructions are sent directly. Do I need to know what's wrong before I get in touch? No. You can have a concern, a hunch, or a wish to take a more deliberate approach to your digital life. You do not need to identify an account, setting or technical fault. The first conversation checks whether Toza fits; examining your digital environment belongs to the first step. A concern alone does not establish that someone has accessed your information. The first step (₪4,000). What do I get for ₪4,000? A senior check-up of your digital life: half a day in person. Toza listens to your concerns, inspects the relevant devices, accounts and access, and explains what the findings mean for you. Where urgent exposure can be addressed safely within the agreed scope, the changes are made with your approval. You keep a written exposure summary with ordered next steps. The ₪4,000 counts in full toward a tier that begins within 30 days. What does it cover, and how long does it take? One main phone and one computer, iPad or second phone, on the same main account (Apple or Android). Toza reviews the relevant identities, accounts, apps, permissions, signed-in devices, recovery routes and shared services. Allow half a day; it typically takes four hours. The visit completes the agreed intake, access mapping, diagnosis and approved urgent first aid. The review stays within your authorized environment and is not a promise to find accounts or devices that have not been identified. What do I receive if I don't continue? A written exposure summary: what was reviewed, what urgent exposure was found, what was changed, what remains and the recommended next steps. You keep it whether or not you continue. There is no automatic continuation to a protection tier. What if you find something serious outside my concern? Toza explains it and obtains your approval before addressing it. If the proposed work expands the scope or price, that is agreed with you first. Finding an urgent problem does not authorize unagreed work or charges. Can you remove spyware or a malicious app? Where it can be done safely within the agreed scope, yes. Urgent first aid during the first step can include removing a malicious app or profile, with your approval. Toza explains each material change before acting. Removing it does not prove who installed it or how. Protection tiers. What does Personal Shield include? Personal Shield costs ₪32,000 for one person, with the first step included. Toza hardens your phone, computer, accounts and home network around your risks, in person. It includes two security keys supplied, configured and tested, new core accounts and essential migration where needed, personal teaching, testing of material changes, a private dated record, a follow-up visit after about four weeks, and questions answered by WhatsApp or Signal for 60 days. What do Personal Shield for Two and Inner Circle include? Personal Shield for Two (₪45,000) is for you and one other person: each person's phone, computer and accounts, your home network and four security keys. Inner Circle (₪70,000) is for a household of up to four, with eight security keys and a review visit at twelve months. Both include the follow-up visit and 60 days of answered questions. If you authorize it, Toza coordinates with your lawyer or family office. In Personal Shield for Two or Inner Circle, who sees whose records? Each person receives a private dated record. The home-network work is recorded separately. Personal details are shared only with that person's consent; being part of the same engagement does not grant access to another person's information. Does migration include all my files and old accounts? Essential migration covers identity, recovery routes and critical-service access where needed. Historical archives and bulk data migration require a separately agreed scope. The written offer identifies the work to be done; the service does not promise unlimited accounts or data transfers. What does the 60-day question line cover? For 60 days from completion of the tier's work, you can send questions by WhatsApp or Signal and receive an answer within one working day. It covers questions and guidance about your setup. It is not new work and not an emergency line; urgent needs go through an urgent visit. There is no remote control of your devices. Privacy and control. Do I give you my passwords or remote access? You control your passwords, recovery codes and authentication throughout. Do not send them in advance. You may need to sign in on your own devices during the work. Toza does not keep your credentials for ongoing use or remotely control your devices. Will you see my messages or photos? Some information may be visible on your own screen where it is necessary for the agreed work, with you present. Toza explains the relevant access and agrees with you what needs to be reviewed. The service is not a general inspection of your private content. Do you keep records or use the cloud? Your situation and the information you share are handled confidentially. Your accounts and shared services may themselves use cloud systems. During the core engagement, Toza does not upload a client dataset to a Toza cloud-analysis platform or retain a copy or comprehensive log of your digital life beyond agreed deliverables and ordinary lawful business records. This does not mean that no cloud services or administrative records exist. Do you monitor my devices or install software? No. Toza does not monitor your devices or install security software on them. The work focuses on the settings and access arrangements within your authorized environment. Every protection tier also includes practical security habits and personal teaching so you understand how to use the resulting setup. What Toza does not do. Can you prove who accessed my account, investigate someone or collect evidence? No. Toza examines your own authorized digital environment and reduces the exposure identified within the agreed scope. It does not investigate another person, attribute past activity, reconstruct events forensically, collect court evidence or give legal advice. Finding a current access path does not prove who used it or how information reached someone else. Changing access cannot recall copies already held elsewhere. Will the other side notice the changes? Some changes are visible. Ending a signed-in session, for example, signs that device out, and some changes create notifications for other users. Toza explains material changes and agrees their timing and sequence with you before acting. It does not promise that changes will go unnoticed. Will this escalate my dispute? Is it legal? Toza works only within your own authorized digital environment, on access you are authorized to manage. Changing recovery details or ending shared access can interrupt access or create notifications, so the effects are explained before you approve them. With your permission, timing can be coordinated with your attorney. Legal strategy stays with your attorney; Toza does not give legal advice. Can you work on company systems or a relative's account? Only where you have lawful access and agreed authority. A dispute does not itself authorize changes to company systems or another person's accounts. A family connection does not authorize work on someone else's account or device. Toza does not determine who is entitled to an account, document or asset, and is not a corporate security audit. Is the dated record a certification or a security guarantee? No. It is a practical, dated account of the work performed, not a forensic report, legal opinion, court-evidence document or certification. A technically blocked or declined action is not presented as a completed change. The record does not guarantee that every possible exposure has been found or removed. How is this different from IT support or a private investigator? Other help is useful for its own scope: Other kinds of help and what each is useful for OptionUseful for IT supportDevice faults, setup, maintenance and agreed technical workApple, Google or Microsoft supportQuestions within that provider's productsA password manager or antivirusManaging credentials; detecting threats the product coversA private investigatorInvestigative work within an agreed lawful scope Toza applies expert judgment to your actual setup: tracing relevant connections, explaining what they allow and selecting changes in a considered sequence. For attorneys. Does a referral authorize access to my client's information? No. A referral does not authorize access to devices, accounts or findings. The client must authorize the work and have lawful authority over the environment being reviewed. Coordination with counsel requires the client's permission; the referring attorney is not automatically a recipient of personal information or findings. What does the attorney-friendly summary contain, and who decides? With the client's explicit authorization, an attorney-friendly summary can describe the work and remaining issues. The client decides what may be disclosed. It is a practical account of the work, not legal advice or a forensic report, and it does not establish what another person did. Can timing be coordinated with proceedings? Yes, with the client's permission. Timing of changes can be coordinated with counsel around a filing, a negotiation or a hearing. Legal strategy remains with the attorney; the client authorizes technical changes. How does referral work commercially? A referral fee is paid when a referred client's first step is paid, and a further fee if the client continues to a protection tier. Amounts and terms are in a one-page agreement. Discuss a referral Prices and timing. How does the ₪4,000 first step count toward a tier? In full, when the tier's work begins within 30 days of completion of the first step. You then pay the balance: ₪28,000 for Personal Shield, ₪41,000 for Personal Shield for Two or ₪66,000 for Inner Circle. After day 30, the tier is charged at its full price. If the first step shows you need the next tier, you pay that tier's price less the ₪4,000 already paid, within the same 30 days. What if the first step shows I need more than a tier includes? Toza proposes the next tier, with its full allowance, before any work begins. Larger households, several residences or household staff receive one fixed price in writing after the first step, from ₪90,000. There are no per-device or per-hour charges. Can you come urgently, and what does it cost? Availability is confirmed before you pay. For an accepted urgent booking, arrival is within four hours of both Toza's acceptance and receipt of payment. This is an arrival commitment, not a four-hour completion promise. The surcharge is ₪4,800, added to the agreed service price; at weekends or holidays it is ₪6,000 instead. What happens after the 60 days? Past clients can continue with Annual Care: the question line on the same terms for twelve months, a check visit, setup of a new or replaced phone or computer, a replacement security key and an update to the dated record. It costs ₪12,000 a year for one person, ₪15,000 for two and ₪20,000 for a household of up to four. Join within six months of the question line ending.
